camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeDetachedBackups --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2021-03-15T16:00Z' --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --PageNumber 1 --BackupMode Automated --StartTime '2021-03-01T16:00Z' --BackupId 3270000 --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --BackupStatus Success
description_en: Queries the data backup files of an ApsaraDB RDS instance that is released
description_zh: 该接口用于查看已被释放的RDS MySQL实例的备份集列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-detached-backups --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --backup-id 3270000 --backup-status Success --backup-mode Automated --start-time 2021-03-01T16:00Z --end-time 2021-03-15T16:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDetachedBackups

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success
Failed
parameters.help_zh:
备份集状态，取值：
Success：已完成备份
Failed：备份失败
parameters.name: backup_status

parameters.help_en:
The backup method. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值：

Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

BackupDownloadURL.description_en: The URL that is used to download the diagnostic report over the Internet. If the diagnostic report cannot be downloaded, an empty string is returned
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh: 公网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则为空串

BackupEndTime.description_en:
The end time of the backup task.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

BackupId.description_en: The ID of the backup set

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en: The URL that is used to download the log file over an internal network. If the log file cannot be downloaded, an empty string is returned
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh: 内网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则为空串

BackupMethod.description_en:
The method that is used to generate the data backup file. Valid values:

Logical: logical backup
Physical: physical backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方式，返回值：

Logical：逻辑备份
Physical：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup method. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，返回值：

Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

BackupStartTime.description_en:
The start time of the backup task.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

BackupStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success
Failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份集状态，返回值：

Success：已完成备份
Failed：备份失败

BackupType.description_en:
The backup type of the backup file. Valid values:

FullBackup
IncrementalBackup
BackupType.description_zh:
备份类型，返回值：

FullBackup：全量备份
IncrementalBackup：增量备份

ConsistentTime.description_en:
The point in time at which the data in the backup set is consistent. The return value of this parameter is a timestamp.

If the instance runs MySQL 5.6, a timestamp is returned. Otherwise, the value 0 is returned
ConsistentTime.description_zh:
备份集的一致性时间点。返回值为时间戳。

仅MySQL 5.6返回本参数，其他版本返回0

HostInstanceID.description_en: The ID of the instance that generates the backup set. This parameter is used to indicate whether the instance that generates the backup set is a primary instance or a secondary instance
HostInstanceID.description_zh: 产生备份集的实例编号，用于区分该备份集产生于主实例或备实例

IsAvail.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set is available. Valid values:

0: The backup set is unavailable.
1: The backup set is available
IsAvail.description_zh:
备份集是否可用，返回值：

0：不可用
1：可用

MetaStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set that is used to restore individual databases or tables. Valid values:

OK: The backup set is normal.
LARGE: The backup set contains an abnormally large number of tables. It cannot be used to restore individual databases or tables.
EMPTY: The backup set is generated from a failed backup task
MetaStatus.description_zh:
库表恢复的备份集状态，返回值：

OK：正常。
LARGE：表数量过多，不能用于库表恢复。
EMPTY：备份失败的备份集

StoreStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the data backup file can be deleted. Valid values:

Enabled
Disabled
StoreStatus.description_zh:
该数据备份是否可删除，返回值：

Enabled：可删除
Disabled：不可删除

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
